caption.body:
Free export costing sheet: know your real price before you quote.

Many first-time exporters quote a number that forgets packing, port charges, freight or insurance. This sheet walks you from ex-factory cost to your FOB and CIF price, step by step, so your margin is not a guess.

It is a planning sheet. Use your own quotes for freight and charges.

leadmagnet.subtitle: From ex-factory cost to your FOB and CIF price

sections.heading: 2. Shipping costs
items: Get a freight quote for sea or air
Note which Incoterm you are quoting (FOB, CIF)
Add a small buffer for exchange-rate changes

sections.heading: 3. Price and check
items: Calculate the FOB and CIF price
Check the total against the buyer's target price
Write the quote with its validity date
